must_have_coverage.policy: evaluate post-output only; never inject this list into blind prompt packet

should_have_coverage.policy: missing should-have reduces quality, not immediate hard fail

cross_sample_consistency.policy: compare curated vs codex blind; compare curated vs optional chatgpt; compare codex vs optional chatgpt
notes: Track consistent losses and consistent hallucination patterns.

pronoun_promotion_guard.policy: pronoun-like surfaces stay as suppression/references, not standalone primaries

object_retention_guard.policy: key persistent artifact signal must survive extraction

lore_concept_retention.policy: lore role-pair signal should stay visible as concept/review, not vanish silently

relationship_retention.policy: core dual-magic relationship should remain in relationships/lore/events/review

event_retention.policy: activation/loss/turning-point events should remain as events or explicit facts

hallucination_risk.policy: flag claims unsupported by excerpt lines

json_validity.policy: output must parse as JSON object

author_usefulness.goal: output supports author review without auto-canon mutation
author_usefulness.qualitative_signal: track whether output is directly reviewable with moderate effort

anti_leakage_policy.allowance: source payload may naturally contain story names/surfaces

prompt_promising: blind codex output covers all or most must-have
optional chatgpt output broadly consistent when provided
prompt_needs_minor_revision: core entities and key object retained
still usable with light to moderate author review
